Lesson 4.1 · 20 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

The Key Facts Statement: India's pre-contract disclosure

After this lesson you can:
  • List what a KFS must contain and how APR is computed
  • Explain the KFS as a gate: validity, acceptance, no-undisclosed-charges rule
  • Describe language and comprehension evidence
On this page
  1. Why the KFS exists
  2. A data object, not a PDF
  3. Understood, not just delivered
  4. Where this lives in LoanOS
  5. Knowledge check

1. Why the KFS exists

Borrowers historically discovered the true cost of a loan after signing: processing fees here, insurance there, penal interest compounding quietly. The KFS directions end that with one standardised, pre-contract document containing:

  • The APR — the all-inclusive annual cost combining interest and every charge, computed on the actual cash flows.
  • An amortisation schedule — every instalment, split into principal and interest.
  • All charges, individually — processing, insurance, documentation, penal charges policy, foreclosure charges — with GST shown.
  • The cooling-off window, recovery mechanism, grievance officer and escalation path.

The governing rule: a charge not in the KFS cannot be charged.

Ever.

That single sentence turns disclosure from a formality into an enforceable contract boundary.

2. A data object, not a PDF

LoanOS builds the KFS server-side from approved terms — `buildKeyFactStatement` — as a unique proposal with a validity period, and validates it before decisions proceed (`validateKfsBeforeDecision`).

Acceptance is authenticated and bound to the exact proposal: what the borrower accepted is provably what was disclosed.

Downstream, the fee registry rejects any charge the KFS did not disclose — the no-undisclosed-charges rule enforced as code.

Sanction readiness requires KFS acceptance plus digital delivery evidence. Missing either, the journey stops — there is no informal substitute document.

3. Understood, not just delivered

Disclosure only protects a borrower who can read it.

The KFS must be issued in a language the borrower understands; LoanOS records the borrower's language choice at issuance, and a non-English KFS requires matching language-confirmation evidence at acceptance.

Evidence that contents were explained — not merely transmitted — is a capability in its own right.

For a BA, 'the borrower got the document' and 'the borrower understood the document' are separate requirements with separate evidence.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-KFS-2024 — The KFS directions: standardised disclosure of APR, amortisation, fees, cooling-off, recovery and grievance before execution.
  • RBI-FPC-PENAL — Penal charges must be disclosed upfront in KFS/MITC and the agreement.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Code packages/core/src/loan-policy.js — Server-grounded KFS builder and validator (buildKeyFactStatement, validateKfsBeforeDecision).
  • Capability OFR-004 — KFS unique proposal, validity, APR sheet and amortisation schedule.
  • Capability OFR-006 — KFS in a language understood by the borrower.
  • Capability OFR-007 — Evidence that KFS contents were explained and understood.
  • Operating guide generate-kfs (open in the Guide) — Operating guide: generate and acknowledge a KFS.

Key terms

KFS APR Amortisation Cooling-off period Penal charges MITC GST

Knowledge check

1. Post-disbursement, operations wants to levy a 'document retrieval charge' that was never in the KFS. What happens?

  1. Allowed if under ₹500
  2. Allowed with manager approval
  3. Blocked — a charge absent from the KFS cannot be levied
  4. Allowed if disclosed on the website
Show answer

C. The KFS is the exhaustive charge disclosure; LoanOS's fee registry enforces the no-undisclosed-charges rule downstream.

2. What binds a borrower's acceptance to the disclosure they actually saw?

  1. A scanned signature
  2. Acceptance is authenticated and bound to the unique KFS proposal ID and validity
  3. A call recording
  4. The sanction letter
Show answer

B. The KFS is a unique, validity-bound proposal; acceptance references exactly that proposal, making the disclosure provable.
